d:
Andrew Ng, founder of DeepLearning.AI, co-founder of Coursera, founding lead of Google Brain, and an Adjunct Professor of Computer Science at Stanford, joins Stanford professor Diyi Yang for a fireside chat in Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents.
Key questions answered in this fireside chat:
Q: What separates strong AI agent-building teams from weaker ones, according to Andrew Ng?
A: A disciplined error analysis and evals-driven development process, plus knowing when to move from quick prototyping to rigorous golden-set and regression testing.
